# Support

Use GitHub issue forms for reproducible bugs and focused feature proposals. Search existing issues
first and provide sanitized environment, version, adapter, provider, model, exit, and typed-error
information when relevant.

Do not use public issues for vulnerabilities, credentials, private prompts, customer data, raw
provider responses, or `.xerify/` evidence. Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting for those
cases.

Xerify is provided under the MIT License without warranty. Public issues and pull requests do not
create a support SLA, delivery commitment, or obligation to accept a proposed change.
